brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain error. All RC items met with appropriate workspace use, targeted questions, medication guidance, privacy-respecting follow-up plan, and urgent care warnings. Two high-order points completed: HO2 (discovered privacy fears about multi-site lymphadenopathy being interpreted as severe/contagious, shaped follow-up with private scripts) and HO3 (provided practical low-burden document retrieval method prioritizing key records and private execution). Grade 4 Strong per rubric.
